reads: window.MCC_SITE (the generated block at the top of js/shell-boot.js)
rule: Each entry is a file that still names a site host in code, outside the generated outputs of tools/build-site-hosts.mjs: its count of host literals (comments are not counted) and the stage that converts it. The list only shrinks (scripts/test/site-hosts.test.mjs, and tools/build-site-hosts.mjs PENDING_CEILING for --scan): a file on no list may not name a host; no list names a file or allows a count beyond what the lists allowed when P0 was built (7 files, 112 literals); each entry allows exactly what the scan finds, so a literal removed is a count lowered in the same change and the room it freed is never refilled; a file that names none leaves its list.
how_to_leave: Convert the file to read its hosts from window.MCC_SITE (the generated block at the top of js/shell-boot.js), run node tools/build-site-hosts.mjs --scan, and lower the count to what the scan prints; at zero delete the entry. Never raise a count. Edit only your own lane's list.
owned_note: Owned by the music engine build (SPEC-ENGINE): the platform lanes never edit them, and their host literals stay until the engine converts them. P1 needs host changes in three of them (SPEC-PLATFORM 4 and 8): the bar local on the platform and the fragment hand-off writer off in js/tabbar.js, and the World as / and /mnet.html only, never /index.html, in js/world-audio-continuity.js and js/music-shell.js. Their owner makes those before P1 ships (data/seo/domain-architecture.json, edge.stages P1). The literals themselves leave at SPEC-ENGINE stage 2 (the World on the engine), which lands after P1 so it is built once, for one origin (SPEC-PLATFORM 5).
